title: feat(lint)!: refuse a widget filterBindings key that names no declared dashboard filter
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBUKsd8za5Xus285ev54wetJ)_

Fixes #27445

Triage-ref: 6491434802
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` already teaches that a `filterBindings` key is the declared filter's `name` (defaulting to `field`); nothing there teaches an undeclared key, so no `skills/**` edit. Docs updated here: `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增 lint 规则 `dashboard-filter-binding-unknown`(error)。部件 `filterBindings` 的键若不是该仪表盘已声明的过滤器名,`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 和元数据发布门(`422 INVALID_METADATA`)都会拒绝;草稿照常保存,`_diagnostics` 给出同样的结论。消息写明部件 id、错误的键、已声明的过滤器,并给出 Did you mean。
- 为什么改:运行时按已声明过滤器的名字去读绑定,未声明的键永远不会被读到。拼错的退出(`{ regoin: false }`)会让部件仍被那个过滤器筛选,数字悄悄变了。
- 风险与回滚:BREAKING(收窄),ADR-0087 登记 D3 条目 `ui-dashboard-filter-binding-unknown-refused`,无 D2(盘点没有任何生产者写出未声明的键)。已存的 `sys_metadata` 仪表盘照常加载,下次保存/发布才会被拒。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` 的 (a-1) 段。
- 两分钟验证:`cd packages/lint && pnpm exec vitest run src/validate-widget-bindings.test.ts -t "dashboard-filter-binding-unknown"`,预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(需合同复核)。

## What changes

**One new error id in `validateWidgetBindings`.** For every widget, each key of `filterBindings` must name a filter the dashboard declares. The declared names are the ones the rule's existing `dashboardFilterDefs` builds, the same set objectui's `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` builds at render time: each `globalFilters[]` entry under its `name` (its `field` when unnamed), and `dateRange` only when the dashboard declares `dateRange`. A key outside that set is reported at `dashboards[i].widgets[j].filterBindings.<key>`:

> widget "kpi_deals" binds `filterBindings.regoin`, but dashboard "deal_board" declares no filter named `regoin` (declared: dateRange, region), so the binding is never read

with the fix `Rename the key to a declared filter name, or delete the entry. Did you mean "region"?` (a `dateRange` key on a dashboard with no `dateRange` gets "Declare `dateRange` on the dashboard, or delete the `dateRange` entry."). The check runs before the dataset limb because it needs no dataset, and it is not suppressible.

**Why error, not the `chart-field-unknown` warning tier.** #15463 demoted `chart-field-unknown` because its three keys only re-dress the same numbers. A `filterBindings` key decides which rows the widget counts: a misspelled opt-out leaves the widget scoped by the filter the author opted it out of, and a misspelled re-target leaves the filter on its default field. Triage 6491434802 graded it a refusal at draft and publish.

**Route.** The rule rides `validateWidgetBindings`, which is already on the `dashboard` runtime-gate path with per-rule `surfaces` (the 2026-08-15 ruling's class), so the publish door refuses it with no new wiring and a stored row is never judged on load. No spec superRefine: `DashboardWidgetSchema` cannot see its dashboard's filters, and a parse refusal would move the load path.

- `packages/lint`: the rule and `DASHBOARD_FILTER_BINDING_UNKNOWN` (barrel-exported), its `os explain` entry in `rule-explanations.ts`, the module docblock bullet.
- `packages/spec`: `DashboardWidgetSchema.filterBindings` TSDoc and `.describe()` name the rule and the valid keys (`content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx` regenerated); ADR-0087 D3 entry `18.ui-dashboard-filter-binding-unknown-refused` (no conversion: only the author knows which filter a misspelled key meant).
- Docs: a row in the "Where a Filter's `field` Resolves" table and a paragraph under Per-Widget Filter Bindings (`dashboards.mdx`); a paragraph in `validating-metadata.mdx`.
- Changeset `27445-dashboard-filter-binding-unknown.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/spec` minor, marker `registered ui-dashboard-filter-binding-unknown-refused`.

## Census (Phase 1)

Measured on main `273137d2` and the public HotCRM clone at `47a0666`:

- Producers: 0 offenders. Showcase `showcase_revenue_pulse` (keys `dateRange`, `region`; declares both) and `showcase_ops_dashboard` (`task_status`; declared); platform `system_overview` (`created_at`; an unnamed `globalFilters` entry whose name defaults to its field); HotCRM `executive_dashboard`, `sales_dashboard`, `crm_overview_dashboard`, `service_dashboard` (`dateRange`, `owner_id`, `lead_source`, `type`, `priority`; all declared, the unnamed entries by field). `docs/**` and `skills/**` snippets are widget-array fragments. So no D2.
- `dateRange` is valid only when declared: lint's `dashboardFilterDefs`, objectui's `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` and `@objectstack/verify`'s dashboard-window proof all build the `dateRange` def only when `dash.dateRange` is set, so an undeclared one was inert everywhere.
- Studio's widget inspector writes `filterBindings` rows only for declared filter defs. Renaming or removing a global filter does not prune existing widget bindings; that dashboard's next save is now refused naming the stale key, which the widget's generic `Filter Bindings` form row can delete.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.test.ts` (new describe, 12 cases): the card's body (exact message, path and fix), re-target spelling with one finding per key, declared keys including `dateRange` pass, an unnamed `globalFilters` entry bound by `field`, a custom `name` replaces the field as the key, `dateRange` only when declared, a dashboard with no filters, judged with no dataset and not suppressible, silent without `filterBindings`, gates `validate` and `build`, the `os explain` entry.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.test.ts`: the door accept-set pin goes from five ids to six, and a new case pins both halves at the door (a declared binding publishes; `regoin` is refused at its path with the declared list and the Did you mean).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`: a seventh case on the real save/read/publish seams (the draft saves, reads `valid: false` with the publish's words, the publish answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`); and a stored-row pair: a row written with the authoring gate off loads with `{ regoin: false }` intact, and its next save is refused 422 naming the key and `(declared: region)`. The stub engine's matcher learned `$in`, which the active read's type clause uses.
- Ablation: with the rule's check replaced by `continue`, 10 lint cases go red; restored, green.

## Verification

Head `4759433d`, off main `273137d2`.

- Under `os-verify-lock`: build of the `@objectstack/lint...` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol...` closures exit 0; `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated` exit 0 (after `gen:docs` for the describe); `@objectstack/spec` `test` (750 files, 22313 tests) and `test:repo` (86 files, 1419 tests) exit 0; `@objectstack/lint` test (177 files, 7602 tests) and typecheck exit 0; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` test (279 files passed, 4 skipped; 21777 tests) and typecheck exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 107 derived families, each run with its exit recorded. 103 exit 0 on the first pass; four exit 3 for prerequisites (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched; `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` need a full build). After `git fetch origin 621a4876` and a full `turbo run build` under the lock (11m38s on a shared box), all four exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 107 derived, 107 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, all exit 0.
- ESLint on the changed source and test files: 0 errors.
